scheme_name: National Buildings Construction Corporation (NBCC) Startup Tie-up
overview: The National Buildings Construction Corporation (NBCC) Startup Tie-up scheme is designed to foster collaboration between NBCC and startups, particularly in the construction and infrastructure sectors. The scheme aims to leverage innovative solutions from startups to enhance NBCC's project execution, sustainability, and technological adoption. It provides a platform for startups to showcase their products and services, potentially leading to pilot projects or long-term partnerships with NBCC.
objectives: To identify and collaborate with innovative startups in construction, infrastructure, and related sectors
To integrate startup-led technological solutions into NBCC's projects for improved efficiency and sustainability
To provide startups with opportunities for pilot projects, validation, and scaling through NBCC's network
To foster innovation in the construction industry by bridging the gap between government enterprises and emerging enterprises
To support the growth of startups by offering access to NBCC's expertise, resources, and market access
eligibility: Startups registered in India with a focus on construction technology, infrastructure innovation, sustainable building materials, smart city solutions, or related domains. The startup must have a minimum viable product (MVP) or prototype and be registered under the Startup India initiative or equivalent recognition.
benefits: Opportunity to pilot solutions with NBCC on live projects, technical mentorship from NBCC experts, access to NBCC's infrastructure and testing facilities, potential for commercial contracts or long-term partnerships, visibility through NBCC's platforms and networks, and support in refining product-market fit.
financial_support: The scheme does not provide direct financial grants or equity investment. Instead, support is in-kind through access to NBCC's projects, infrastructure, and expertise for piloting and validation. Any financial engagement would be based on commercial terms agreed upon post-validation.
application_process: 1. Visit the NBCC official website and navigate to the Startup Tie-up section. 2. Review the eligibility criteria and focus areas for collaboration. 3. Prepare a company profile, product/service description, and details of innovation or technology offered. 4. Submit the application via the designated portal or email address provided on the website. 5. Await initial screening by NBCC's innovation cell. 6. Shortlisted startups will be invited for a presentation or demo. 7. Upon successful evaluation, NBCC will discuss pilot project scope and terms.
required_documents: Details of technology or innovation offered
Information on existing clients or pilot projects (if any)
Team profile and key personnel details
Financial statements or turnover details (if available)
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
caveats: Selection is based on the relevance of the startup's solution to NBCC's current and upcoming projects
NBCC does not guarantee financial support or equity investment under this scheme
Intellectual property rights must be clearly defined and agreed upon before any collaboration
Startups must comply with NBCC's safety, quality, and environmental standards
The scheme does not provide incubation infrastructure or seed funding
